title: Distill: usage of every prompt in a work window, per item
goal: Distill writes kb/_querylog/work/<yyyy-mm>/<run-id>.jsonl beside the run file: a header (run, reader, counts), then one line per item worked in the run's sessions with the item id, the prompt count and the summed kbusage main and sub counts of every prompt between the item's claim and its done or release (kb prompts or not), and one shared line per session that worked an item: the item ids it worked and the summed counts of its prompts outside any window; no session, prompt or transcript data; querylog.py check gates the file (shape, counts, ids, duplicates) with a planted failure per gate; sessions that worked no item stay unrecorded.

gates.question: The accounting model on ST-6bi7oe6y needs shared tokens: the counts of prompts outside any claim-to-done window, in sessions that worked an item. Approve the work sidecar recording them (counts only, one line per such session with the item ids it worked, no session id or text)?
options: approve: counts only, sessions that worked an item
no: windows only; cost prints direct and attributed, no shared or session total
gates.recommendation: approve: counts only, sessions that worked an item
gates.answer: approve: counts only, sessions that worked an item

notes: Same counts shape as the usage sidecar (kbusage record main and sub), without steps. The item id alone is stored; rollup resolves the hierarchy later (ST-6bi7oe6y) and counts a shared line once for a subtree that holds any of its items. Store never gets session_id, prompt_id, transcript_path, branch or cwd.
